desc: The ULTRX Verse Safety Glasses offer exceptional eye protection with a modern design tailored for various environments. Ideal for shooting ranges, construction sites, or DIY projects, these glasses ensure clarity and safety with their high-impact polycarbonate lenses. The rotating and extendable temples provide a customizable fit, while the padded nose piece guarantees comfort during extended wear. Built to comply with ANSI Z87+ standards, these glasses blend protection with comfort for a versatile safety solution.
